stories.title: Scotland's papers: Milburn benefits row and crime rates concerns
stories.summary: A review of the front page stories from the daily newspapers in Scotland.

stories.title: BBC drama Shetland to return for 12th series
stories.summary: The new series will be made up of six episodes filmed in locations on the Shetland Isles and across Scotland .

stories.title: Electric bike seizures soar as police warn of growing problem
stories.summary: Police Scotland submits evidence to a Holyrood committee looking at the rise in crime and antisocial behaviour linked to illegal e-bikes and scooters.

stories.title: George thought his funeral was paid for – but now his wife will get nothing when he dies
stories.summary: George Davies made payments to an insurance company for 17 years - but now isn't entitled to a penny.

stories.title: GTA 6: My wife and daughter have signed a 'do not disturb' contract
stories.summary: Painter and decorator Sean Little has booked the week off work to play the new Grand Theft Auto game.

stories.title: M8 westbound reopens after bus bursts into flames near Livingston
stories.summary: Footage shows large flames engulfing the vehicle and there were reports of long queues.

stories.title: Surgeon warns 'nothing has been learned' over NHS Grampian safety
stories.summary: Prof Zygmunt Krukowski says it is "deeply distressing" to see ongoing failings in how major incidents are investigated.

stories.title: Worker at care home in BBC investigation given warning
stories.summary: Oluwabunmi Salami admitting causing distress and agitation to a vulnerable resident.

stories.title: Couple die following crash in Aberdeenshire
stories.summary: Emergency services were called to a single-vehicle crash on the A93 between Banchory and Inchmarlo on 10 November.

stories.title: Grand Theft Auto staff sacked as 'shock tactic' to punish trade union activity, tribunal hears
stories.summary: The claim was made during closing submissions in a case brought by 23 former employees who said they were sacked for trying to unionise.

stories.title: Man charged with death by dangerous driving after four-year-old killed in crash
stories.summary: A 28-year-old man has been charged with dangerous driving after the crash that took place in Bathgate on 6 November.

stories.title: What does the Milburn report mean for Scotland?
stories.summary: Alan Milburn says his diagnosis of problem applies across the UK - yet the bulk of his report relates only to England.
